node.statement: Cramer box and negative-beta mass: for every t and j, |a_t(j)|<=2; hence lambda_s(j)=1-a_s(j)<=3 for every j. Also sum_j max(-beta_s(j),0)<=delta(P). For the Cramer bound, if a_t(j)=0 there is nothing to prove; otherwise replacing pivot row p_{u_t} by actual row p_j gives an actual-row basis with Gram volume |a_t(j)|*Vol(U), so |a_t(j)|*Vol(U)<=Vol_max(P)<=2*Vol(U). The negative-beta inequality is the definition of delta(P) applied to the pivot row u_s.
